close_reason: Updated PLAN.md JmapResponse.created_ids and JmapRequest.created_ids to match wire.rs (HashMap<Id, Id>, RFC 8620 §3.3/§3.4). NOTE: same Planned Public API section still has other unrelated drift from the actual wire.rs surface — JmapResponse.session_state shown as String but code uses State newtype, and both JmapRequest/JmapResponse omit the workspace-extras-policy extra field that the same PLAN.md describes at lines 111-145. Out of scope for this bead (which was specifically scoped to created_ids); recommend a single sweep bead to align all of PLAN.md's Planned Public API block with the current wire.rs surface if anyone wants to file it.
description: crate-jmap-types/PLAN.md line 78 says `pub created_ids: Option<HashMap<String, String>>`. crate-jmap-types/src/wire.rs lines 23, 45 say `Option<HashMap<Id, Id>>`. Trigger: any contributor reading PLAN.md as design contract. Bad behavior: docs lie about the API surface. Fix: update PLAN.md to match the implementation (HashMap<Id, Id>) — this is pre-existing but survived the docs sweep in commit 0efd01a. JmapResponse.created_ids is also documented inconsistently in the PLAN.md `Planned Public API` section.
title: PLAN.md describes created_ids as HashMap<String,String> but code is HashMap<Id,Id>
